governance_raw.evidence: The protocol has rebranded from Tokemak ($TOKE) to Auto Finance ($AUTO) and is actively migrating users to the new Autopools system, as indicated by the homepage message '$TOKE is now $AUTO. Migrate to continue earning rewards.'

lifecycle_signal.governance_evidence: The protocol has rebranded from Tokemak ($TOKE) to Auto Finance ($AUTO) and is actively migrating users to the new Autopools system, as indicated by the homepage message '$TOKE is now $AUTO. Migrate to continue earning rewards.'

topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 288 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 47 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 11 functional families. Its contracts share 50 common project-authored base contract(s) (systemcomponent, securitybase, curvedestinationvault). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
